comment: No source is published. UT_OX checks that the left neighbour's model is UT-P or UT-OX before reading its expander message, so a chain of them all work from the one polyphonic input; it then passes the same message on to the right, but only when the module there is a UT-OX. WITH NO VALID NEIGHBOUR IT DOES NOT FALL SILENT IN THE OBVIOUS WAY. The fallback builds a message of sixteen zero values, so the selector still moves across sixteen positions and the trigger output still fires as the CV is swept, while the signal output stays at 0V. Unlike UT-P this module is mono throughout: the CV jack is read at channel one only and both outputs are single-channel. The voltage range menu is the same one UT-P carries, from the shared UT_Base::BaseWidget, saved under the key voltageRange and starting at 0V - 10V. The panel has no IN jack and no GATE output. Panel lettering came from https://library.vcvrack.com/screenshots/400/DigitalAtavism/UT-OX.png; the plugin ships no panel SVG.
